newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - SAUDI NEWSPAPERS - AUG 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - SAUDI NEWSPAPERS - AUG 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia to become a World Trade Organisation member by the year 2002.
- New Jeddah mayor vows to end flooding problem which the city suffers annually.
- Saudi Arabia will deport expatriates who have AIDS, whether they are overstayers or holding regular residence permits.
- National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia orders three container ships from South Korea at a cost of $127 million.
- Father of a young man who was shot dead following a disagreement pardons his son's killer.
- Saudi Industrial Development Fund agrees to extend loans worth 127 million riyals to six industrial projects.
- Saudi Arabia spent $171 million on advertising in the first half of 1997.
- Defence minister finances a $12 million road project in Yemen.
- Saudi official signs two drainage contracts in eastern province worth seven million riyals.
